# LegatorOCR v0.2.0-pre.30 (pre-release)

Changes since pre.29. Written and tried by the author's assistant on one Linux machine. The automated test suite passes on CI runners for Linux x86-64 and arm64, Windows x86-64 and arm64, and macOS (Apple silicon and Intel). A smoke step also runs the command line on a generated page on each of them. **Nothing was tried by hand on Windows, macOS or arm64, and no photo batch was processed there.**

**Documentation**
- **Video tour of the GUI**: 11 silent clips that go through every function of the window (adding scans, preview modes, page adjustments, zones and content box, all settings panels, profiles, export and projects, the "All options" window, language, About, optional modules, undo/redo). Romanian and English subtitles. In `docs/video/gui/` and in the *Window tour* section of the project page.
- The clips were recorded on Linux from the real program (this version) with generated sample scans, not with real book photos. Drag-and-drop into the window is described in a caption, not shown. The text of the non-English interfaces is machine-translated and was not shown in the clips.
- README points to the clips.

**Changed**
- Signing (`--sign`) now looks for an OpenSSL 3 build with CAdES support in the usual Homebrew locations as well as `PATH` (`LEGATOROCR_OPENSSL` overrides), and says so clearly when none exists. macOS ships LibreSSL, which cannot sign.
- CI also builds and tests Linux arm64, Windows arm64 and macOS Intel.

**Correction to pre.29's notes**: they said the test suite ran on Linux, Windows and macOS Apple silicon only; the extra platforms above were added after.

**Verified**: unit tests and clippy; CI on the nine jobs above; each clip was checked beforehand in a dry run with screenshots; clips 1–5 and 11 were also reviewed from the final recordings, while clips 6–10 were not re-reviewed frame by frame after recording; the About window in clip 11 shows this version.
**Not verified**: the GUI on Windows, macOS and arm64 (only unit tests and the command-line smoke step run there); real photos on those systems; winget manifest (still pre.28, not validated).

**Known limits** (unchanged): photos that are not pages are kept; a large hand holding the page can stay; small notches where a finger was removed; a folded page corner can be cut diagonally; tables and contents pages read few words; OCR can misread characters such as `@`.
